title: VEON Strengthens Leadership to Accelerate Digital Growth, Entertainment and AI Infrastructure
body_markdown:
16 Nov 2026


#### VEON Strengthens Leadership to Accelerate Digital Growth, Entertainment and AI Infrastructure


**Dubai, New York, November 16, 2026:** VEON Ltd. (NASDAQ: VEON), a global digital operator, today announces four leadership appointments to advance its digital growth strategy, expand its entertainment business and strengthen its satellite connectivity and AI infrastructure capabilities.


The appointments are:


- **Roland Buerk** , Chief Communications Officer.
- **Sami Nashwan** , Chief Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) Officer.
- **Ilya Polshakov** , Chief Satellite and AI Infrastructure Officer, effective January 1, 2027.
- **Lasha Tabidze** , Chief Executive Officer of VEON Digital Entertainment.


“These appointments will bring greater focus and accountability to the next phase of VEON’s growth,” said Kaan Terzioglu, Chief Executive Officer of VEON Group. “We are expanding our reach through partner networks, building digital entertainment businesses and developing the satellite and AI infrastructure that will power new services. Together, these capabilities will advance our ambition to serve customers across all 1,440 minutes of their day and use augmented intelligence to create a better life for all.”


**Roland Buerk - Chief Communications Officer**
Roland will lead VEON’s external and internal communications, strengthening the Group’s corporate reputation, stakeholder engagement and communication of its digital and AI transformation.


He joins from Mubadala Investment Company, where he has served as Senior Vice President, Corporate Communications since 2022. Previously, he held senior communications roles at DP World and Nissan, following a career in journalism with ITN and the BBC, including as the BBC’s South Asia and Tokyo correspondent.


**Sami Nashwan - Chief MVNO Officer**
As Chief MVNO Officer, Sami will drive VEON’s virtual digital operator strategy, expanding access to its connectivity and digital services through partner networks. His mandate will focus on capital efficient growth, reaching new customers and creating new revenue streams from services that meet their everyday needs.


He joins from BeyondONE, where he has served as Global Chief Growth Officer and Acting Chief Executive Officer of its Kuwait operation. His previous roles include Chief Commercial Officer at BOTIM, Senior Vice President for Middle East Strategy at Huawei and Chief Consumer Officer at Mobily, Saudi Arabia.


**Ilya Polshakov - Chief Satellite and AI Infrastructure Officer**
Ilya will expand his existing Group responsibilities to advance satellite connectivity and develop cloud and AI infrastructure businesses across VEON’s markets. He will lead engagement with global technology partners and hyperscalers to translate these capabilities into commercially viable services.


Currently VEON’s Global Head of Satellite and Cloud Business and Kyivstar’s Chief New Business Streams Officer, Ilya brings extensive experience in developing businesses across AI, big data, cloud, cybersecurity and satellite connectivity.


**Lasha Tabidze - Chief Executive Officer, VEON Digital Entertainment**
Lasha will lead the development and growth of VEON Digital Entertainment, bringing greater strategic and commercial focus to the Group’s entertainment business, which serves 81 million customers across VEON’s markets.


Lasha has successfully led VEON’s DO1440 portfolio as Chief Digital Operations Officer. His new mandate will be to build a scalable entertainment business spanning content, platforms and distribution, working with VEON’s operating companies and external partners to deepen customer engagement, expand audiences and grow digital revenues. Alongside this focus, Lasha will continue to support selected strategic digital initiatives across the Group.


Lasha, Roland, Sami and Ilya will be part of the VEON Leadership Team, report directly to the Group Chief Executive Officer and be based in Dubai.


**About VEON**
VEON is a global digital operator providing connectivity and digital services that empower individuals and drive economic growth. Through its digital operator strategy, VEON is expanding its role in customers’ everyday lives across financial services, healthcare, education, entertainment and enterprise solutions. VEON is listed on NASDAQ. For more information, visit www.veon.com.
